node_definition.done_when: The evidence fragment names the mechanism, with the observation that shows it: an exit status, a signal, a traced exec or a reproduction log. A loop of each of the three files, 30 times under pytest -n 8 beside a CPU load generator, finishes with no crashed worker at head, while the base revision under the same loop crashes at least once. If 30 base iterations do not reproduce a crash, the loop is raised until it does, and the iteration count is reported. The three files are recorded as flat baseline_suite and after_suite records. Every loop runs in a temporary RECKON_HOME with its basetemp under the run's scratch directory, inside a 55 minute budget.
node_definition.goal: Make a-follower-outlives-its-monitor §12 hold as its section states. Identify, from evidence, what ends the pytest-xdist worker process during the follower and producer re-arm tests that crashed workers tonight (tests/test_follower_rearm_shows_nothing_twice.py, tests/test_follow_rearm_continues.py, tests/test_producer_takes_new_code.py): the worker's exit status or signal, an exec observed with a stub, or a reproduction under load. Then confine whatever re-executes, exits or signals to a child process the test owns, so no such test can end its runner.
